title: Agent Behavior Maps: Locating Agents by What They Would Do, Without Running Them
abstract: arXiv:2610.30014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents with similar success rates can follow different action sequences. An Agent Behavior Map represents LLM-harness combinations using centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, without requiring new environment rollouts from the target agent. We derive error bounds relating squared coordinate distances to trajectory KL under explicit assumptions, and across eight cross-scored models the distances track the directly measured trajectory KL in rank order. Across 100 LLMs and four environments, ALFWorld-based coordinates support performance prediction and identify behavioral similarities. In ALFWorld, these similarities persist after controlling for success rates and model size, including across model families. As an extension, harness-component displacements approximately compose, with accuracy varying across components and environments.

translated_title: 智能体行为地图：无需运行智能体，通过“它们会做什么”来定位智能体
translated_abstract: 具有相似成功率的LLM智能体可能遵循不同的动作序列。智能体行为地图利用共享参考轨迹上的中心化动作对数似然来表示LLM-框架组合，而无需对目标智能体进行新的环境回放。我们在明确假设下推导出将坐标距离平方与轨迹KL散度联系起来的误差界，并且在八个交叉评分的模型中，这些距离在排序上与直接测量的轨迹KL散度保持一致。在100个LLM和四个环境的实验中，基于ALFWorld的坐标支持性能预测并识别行为相似性。在ALFWorld中，即使控制了成功率和模型规模，这些相似性依然存在，包括跨模型家族的相似性。作为扩展，框架组件的位移近似满足可组合性，其精度在不同组件和环境之间有所差异。
tldr: 提出“智能体行为地图”方法，利用共享参考轨迹上的中心化动作对数似然为LLM智能体定位，无需实际运行目标智能体即可刻画其行为特征、追踪轨迹KL散度并支持性能预测与行为相似性分析。
en_tdlr: Agent Behavior Maps locate LLM agents via centered action log-likelihoods on shared reference trajectories, characterizing their behavior, tracking trajectory KL divergence, and enabling performance prediction without running the agents.
